text_block_list.text: The day of her debut race arrived. Thanks to immense expectations, Air Groove stood as the overwhelming favorite.
However—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Leading pack hits final straight! Top favorite Air Groove surges forward with razor-sharp acceleration!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Can she reach! Can she reach it?! The wire is right there! Will Air Groove make it?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Goal! "The Empress" Air Groove finishes in an agonizing second place!
Pushed to absolute exhaustion, the frontrunner held on by a thread—denying Air Groove the crown…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Defeat… Damn it! How utterly pathetic…!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …No. Rage and regret solve nothing. My execution fell short of "The Empress," and this outcome reflects that flaw.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If so, I must push until nothing is lacking…!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen closely. As the athlete in your charge, I demand a schedule revision. Cancel today's rest; we hold a strategy meeting immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We will overhaul the entire training curriculum and reach far higher ground…!
Swallowing bitter defeat, she was already looking toward the next summit. Air Groove never wavered in her pursuit of the ideal Empress.
As her trainer, I wanted to support her burden—starting with clearing space in her packed routine—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you listening? What are you daydreaming about?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Do not tell me you intend to meddle in affairs outside your purview.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I made this explicit at the start: your domain is strictly race training. I tolerate zero interference in my other duties.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Or are you looking to breach our contract?
…Her packed schedule worried me deeply, but one wrong step meant immediate contract termination.
What path should I take? Back in my room that evening, I searched endlessly for an answer—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text: If she keeps burning time on Student Council and mentoring juniors, her personal development will stall! That is why—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove shoulders those duties with deliberate resolve. No one has authority to strip them from her without her consent.
Why does Air Groove dedicate herself so completely to student leadership, even sacrificing her own hours?
First, I need to understand her true motive…!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood. So that brings you before me. 
Hm…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I could explain it myself. Yet mere words will not convey the depth of her ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you wish to share her perspective, should you not witness it firsthand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You approached me out of genuine dedication to her growth. That sincerity reached me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In recognition of that resolve, I shall show you. Follow me.
Guided by Symboli Rudolf, I found Air Groove coaching Mejiro Dober by the far curve of the track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Initial acceleration out of the gate is weak. Increase cadence and lengthen your stride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stride length…? But whenever I focus on stretching out my stride, my pace drops…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your muscle memory hasn't internalized the pacing required for an elongated stride. Here—take this drill.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Place markers at 1.5-meter intervals along the lane. Strike each mark cleanly without breaking speed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Once consistent, expand intervals to 1.8 meters, then 2.0 meters. Incremental adjustments will condition your rhythm naturally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Understood…! Thank you so much, Air Groove-san! I'll try it right away…!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Mejiro Dober struggles with men. Male staff struggled to provide her effective instruction.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove was the first to notice her distress and extend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That Mejiro Dober now trains without fear at this academy is largely due to Air Groove's dedication.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So this is where you were, Suzuka. What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Oh. Um… nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The main track was closed for turf maintenance… When I can't run… I don't really know what to do with myself…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Idling about because of that? Hmph… how typical of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good news. The Student Council just expedited the maintenance schedule. Designated sections are reopened.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Curfew approaches, but knowing you, even ten or twenty minutes on the turf is worth the sprint, correct?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you, Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Whenever Silence Suzuka faced hurdles, Air Groove stepped forward to clear the path.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As Vice President, she works tirelessly to ensure the best possible environment across the entire academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Her devotion elevates the entire student body… And to me as President, she is an irreplaceable right hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So then… did today's observations bring you closer to a resolution?
choice_data_list: I'm going to think it over one more time

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. Refusing rash conclusions is an admirable stance. Hm—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She fretted over carrying all burdens alone, but it seems that sorrow will soon dissolve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Think nothing of it. The road ahead is steep… I wish you good fortune.
My resolve was set… Time to reconsider how to truly stand beside Air Groove.
